card.description:
**Job ID: 116026**

 

The Leonardo DRS Naval Electronics business provides leading naval computing infrastructure, network and data distribution and middleware enterprise services, as well as world-class manufacturing and support capabilities.

**Business Unit**: Naval Electronics
 
**Location**: Eagan, MN
 
**Career Functional Area**: Engineering
 
**Telework Type**: Hybrid
 
**Travel Expectation**: 30%
 
**Schedule**: 9/80

**Job Summary**
---------------

Responsible for establishing and continuously improving the processes, tools, and data-management practices that enable disciplined, compliant, and efficient engineering execution across all programs. Own engineering configuration-management standards, processes and execution releasing the E BOM. Monitor the quality of engineering deliverables identifying opportunities of improvement.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Process Ownership and Excellence**

* Define, deploy, maintain, and continuously improve standardized engineering processes, procedures, work instructions, templates
* Ensure engineering processes are practical for program execution while meeting applicable customer, contractual, quality, regulatory, cybersecurity, and internal requirements.
* Establish process ownership, approval authorities, compliance expectations, training requirements, and periodic process-review cycles.
* Lead process maturity assessments, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

**Engineering Tools and Digital Strategy**

* Define the engineering tools strategy, roadmap, governance model, and deployment plans in partnership with Engineering, IT, Quality, Supply Chain, and program teams.
* Lead deployment, adoption, administration requirements, user support models, and continuous improvement of engineering tools, including product lifecycle management, requirements management, analysis, collaboration, and configuration-management tools.
* Ensure tools, workflows, data structures, and integrations support disciplined engineering execution, traceability, release control, and reliable engineering data.
* Capture user and program needs; prioritize enhancements, integrations, and new capabilities based on business value, risk reduction, compliance, and program demand.

**Engineering Configuration Management**

* Own the engineering configuration-management process, standards, governance, and associated tool workflows.
* Establish common rules for engineering baselines, configuration identification, revision control, change management, release authorization, and configuration-status accounting.
* Ensure configuration-management processes support full traceability between requirements, drawings, parts, assemblies, bills of material, changes, verification evidence, and released product definition.
* Define the governance framework for configuration control boards and ensure appropriate technical, quality, programmatic, manufacturing, supply-chain, and customer inputs are incorporated where required.

**Job Responsibilities (Cont.)**
--------------------------------

**Program Configuration-Management Support**

* Provide configuration-management process leadership and tailored support to programs from proposal through product support.
* Support development, review, and maintenance of program Configuration Management Plans and related configuration-management deliverables.
* Establish program-specific configuration baselines, release schedules, change-control workflows, approval matrices, and reporting appropriate to contractual and product requirements.
* Support programs in resolving configuration-management issues, ensuring timely decisions and minimizing release, production, and customer-impact risk.

**Product-Definition Data Integrity**

* Govern the processes for drawing-number creation, part-number assignment, nomenclature, document classification, and engineering-data release.
* Ensure new drawing and part numbers are created, controlled, and uniquely identified in accordance with approved standards and system rules.
* Establish validation controls for engineering drawings, parts, assemblies, and engineering bills of material (EBOMs), including consistency, completeness, revision alignment, and traceability.
* Monitor the integrity of released product-definition data and drive resolution of discrepancies that could affect procurement, manufacturing, verification, sustainment, or customer deliverables.

**Engineering Deliverable Quality and Performance Monitoring**

* Define the quality criteria, review expectations, and performance measures for engineering deliverables.
* Monitor the quality, completeness, timeliness, and first-pass acceptance of engineering outputs, including requirements artifacts, drawings, specifications, analysis reports, test documentation, change packages, and released product data.
* Analyze defects, rework, late changes, release escapes, configuration discrepancies, and recurring nonconformities to identify systemic causes and improvement opportunities.
* Provide leadership with regular visibility into engineering-process performance, deliverable quality trends, compliance risks, and recommended corrective actions.

**Continuous Improvement and Assurance**

* Lead improvement initiatives that strengthen engineering execution, reduce rework, improve data quality, and increase delivery predictability.
* Develop and recommend improvement actions based on performance data, audit findings, lessons learned, user feedback, program needs, and changes in business or customer requirements.
* Verify the effectiveness of implemented improvements and maintain an actionable backlog of process, tool, and data-governance enhancements.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining objective evidence of process compliance, configuration control, tool governance, and engineering-data integrity.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; advanced degree or relevant professional certification preferred
* 10+ years of progressive experience in engineering, engineering operations, configuration management, PLM, quality, or systems engineering within a complex and regulated product environment.
* 5+ years in a leadership role responsible for engineering processes, tools, configuration management, quality, or operational excellence.
* Experience developing and deploying engineering processes, governance controls, workflows, and performance measures.
* Experience leading implementation and improvement of engineering tools, including PLM, requirements-management, design-data management, and configuration-management systems.
* Practical experience with Configuration Management Plans, engineering change control, drawing and part-number management, release control, and EBOM validation.
* Proven record of improving engineering deliverable quality, data integrity, process compliance, and operational efficiency

**Additional Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* Strong knowledge of engineering product-development processes, configuration management, product-data control, and engineering release practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders in a matrix organization.
* Strong analytical, communication, and continuous-improvement skills

**U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.**

*The salary range for this position is $161,180/year- $250,000/year. This range reflects the good faith estimate of pay the employer is willing to offer at the time of posting. Several factors can influence the pay scale, including but not limited to: Federal contract labor categories and contract wage rates, collective bargaining agreements, geographic location, business considerations, scope, and responsibilities of the position, local or other applicable market conditions, and internal equity. Other factors include the candidate’s qualifications such as prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education/training, and certifications. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for: annual performance-based bonuses, equity awards, and overtime pay (for non-exempt employees as applicable. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision), employer matching 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off including vacation, holidays, and sick leave (including ant state-mandated paid sick leave), parental leave benefits, tuition reimbursement, professional development support, and life and disability insurance coverage.*

 

*Taking care of our people is a top priority at Leonardo DRS. We are proud to offer competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a company contribution to a health savings account, telemedicine, life and disability insurance, legal insurance, and a 401(k) savings plan. We champion wellness programs that focus on physical, emotional, and financial well-being. We develop our talent by offering programs and activities to support career-growth, professional development, and skill enhancement. And we understand there is more to life than work, and the importance of offering flexible work schedules with our 9/80 program, competitive vacation, health/emergency leave, paid parental leave, and community service hours.* 

* *Some employees are eligible for limited benefits only*

 

*Leonardo DRS, Inc. and its subsidiaries provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.*

card.title: Director Agentic Talent Programs, Manufacturing
card.description:
The Director, Manufacturing Talent Programs at Phenom is a client-facing, revenue-accountable executive role focused on diagnosing and resolving talent-related constraints for healthcare clients. This position is responsible for conducting in-depth research, building financial models, and engaging senior leadership to drive strategic growth. The Director leads the full client engagement cycle, from initial research to contract closure, ensuring each opportunity is client-validated and measurable. The role offers a competitive compensation package of $250,000–$300,000+ OTE, comprehensive benefits, flexible scheduling, and opportunities for professional growth within a diverse and inclusive organization.

**Job Requirements** 

**Job Description**

Phenom is an applied AI company with a bold mission: help a billion people find the right work. Our platform delivers an AI orchestration layer that sits across the entire talent lifecycle, automating workflows, surfacing intelligence, and deploying agentic capabilities that let enterprises operate at a speed and precision their legacy systems were never built to match.

 
 

We work with the most forward-thinking enterprises in the market, companies that are scaling aggressively, transforming how they operate, and making bold bets on AI to outpace their competition. They range from 5,000 employees to more than one million.

The Director, Manufacturing Talent Programs is a client-facing, revenue-accountable role on Phenom's enterprise team. The Director runs point on strategic account engagements with health systems, hospitals, payers, and post-acute providers. Working directly with CHROs, CPOs, and CFOs, the Director diagnoses the talent-related constraint blocking one of the client's key growth priorities, then designs and sells the Phenom solution that resolves it.

 
 

The Director owns the research and analysis behind each prospect engagement: account research, a documented hypothesis about the client's problem, a map of where that problem shows up operationally, a financial model of what it is costing the client, and a plan for getting the right stakeholders aligned. The Director carries the engagement through the full new client cycle, from first contact to signed contract.

 
 

***If based within 50 miles of Horsham, PA, this would be 5 days/week on-site.***

**What this role is**

* **A revenue-accountable, customer acquisition-focused role:** success is measured by pipeline generated and new customers onboarded.
* **Research and analysis heavy:** the Director builds the account intelligence, financial model, and business case behind every engagement.
* **A role that operates at the executive level:** with CHROs, CPOs, and CFOs as the primary audience.

**What this role is not**

* **Not a demo-led product sale:** the platform walkthrough is a consequence of the diagnosis, not the opening move.
* **Not account management or renewals:** this is new customer acquisition.
* **Not a solutions consulting seat:** the Director carries the number.
* **Not a volume outbound role:** fewer accounts, far more depth per account.

 

**The Talent Constraint in Healthcare**

* **Clinical vacancy caps capacity:** an unfilled nursing line closes beds, and closed beds are patient revenue that does not come back. Staffing is not an HR cost line here, it is a ceiling on throughput.
* **Agency and travel labor is the expensive release valve:** systems that cannot fill permanently pay a premium to fill temporarily. That premium lands in operating margin, where the CFO already sees it.
* **Turnover compounds:** first-year clinical attrition resets the entire ramp, and the replacement cost is a multiple of salary once orientation, preceptorship, and overtime coverage are counted.
* **Credentialing adds lead time no requisition process can compress:** licensure, verification, and privileging mean part of time-to-fill is a compliance problem, not a sourcing problem.
* **Labor markets are local and shift-specific:** a system can be fully staffed in aggregate and critically short on nights in a single market. Aggregate vacancy rates hide the constraint.

**What you'll actually do**

* Research target systems (financials, service line growth plans, reimbursement pressure, and M&A activity) before any outreach
* Build a documented hypothesis on the talent constraint blocking each account's most important growth priority
* Open executive conversations with a specific, researched insight about the account
* Run meetings that test the hypothesis directly with the client and reach a shared diagnosis
* Map the client's current-state hiring process to identify failure points and bottlenecks
* Build a financial model quantifying the cost of the client's current constraint
* Align stakeholders (CHRO, CPO, CFO) to move the engagement through approval
* Build urgency using the financial case itself, rather than deadlines or discounts
* Use AI and LLM tools to accelerate research and sharpen analysis

 

**Core disciplines needed**

**Understand the Business**

**01. Business Intelligence**

For-profit systems file 10-Ks; nonprofit systems publish audited financials and municipal bond disclosures. Read both. Understand operating margin, payer mix, CMS reimbursement pressure, disclosed agency labor spend, and which service lines the system is trying to grow this year. Walk into every meeting already knowing what the business is trying to do.

**02. Hypothesis Construction**

Translate business context into a specific, falsifiable hypothesis about the client's talent constraint before any outreach. Name which growth levers are blocked, and by what, precisely.

**03. Hypothesis-Led Validation**

Run meetings designed to test the hypothesis directly with the client. Ask questions that confirm or disprove the thesis in real time. The goal is a diagnosis the client agrees with, reached together.

**Build the Case**

**04. Process Mapping**

Decompose the client's hiring workflow into current-state swim lanes. Identify handoffs, SLA breaks, and bottlenecks.

**05. Hypercell Design**

Define a discrete, outcome-scoped Phenom deployment tied to a specific talent problem. In healthcare that reads like "med/surg RN, night shift, one metro market, 90-day fill" or "surgical tech, ambulatory surgery centers, three-state region." Each hypercell has a defined job title, location, and job family, a named constraint, and a measurable result.

**06. Financial Modeling**

Quantify the cost of the client's current constraint using the numbers this industry already tracks: agency and travel premium over base rate, revenue per closed bed-day, OR block time lost to staffing, first-year clinical attrition and replacement cost, overtime and shift differential spend. Put a number on the problem before the proposal lands.

**Close the Engagement**

**07. Executive Communication**

Translate operational talent problems into board-level language. Write and speak at the altitude of a CHRO, CPO, or CFO.

**08. Outcome Architecture**

Define success (metric, baseline, target) before the engagement begins. Tie every deliverable to that measurable outcome.

**09. Engagement Orchestration**

Map the buying committee: economic buyer, champion, and any blockers. In health systems the CNO usually feels the problem, the CFO funds the fix, and the CHRO owns the process, while talent acquisition sits a layer below all three. Build alignment across all of them to move the engagement to close.

**Underlying Capabilities**

**Critical Thinking**

Challenges own assumptions before the client does.

**Deep Research**

Synthesizes accounts before any outreach is sent.

**LLM Fluency**

Uses AI to compress prep time and sharpen hypotheses.

**Structured Writing**

Memos and briefs that earn credibility on paper.

**Pattern Recognition**

Applies cross-account learning to new pursuits.

**Intellectual Curiosity**

Genuinely wants to understand how businesses work.

**Data Literacy**

Reads workforce dashboards, reasons from trends.

**Competitive Intelligence**

Knows Eightfold, Beamery, Avature, and Workday cold, plus the industrial and life sciences staffing firms and workforce management incumbents already inside these accounts.

**Operating Mindset**

**Think like a Consultant.** Diagnose before prescribing. Lead with insight.

**Diagnose like a Physician.** Identify root causes, not symptoms. Map the constraint before naming the fix.

**Build like an Architect.** Design the solution before proposing it. Precision over comprehensiveness.

**Communicate like a CFO.** Translate everything to financial impact. Give the executive a one-sentence version of the model.

**What we're looking for**

**Required**

* 7+ years doing at least one of the following: Fortune 1000 consulting in HR; leading a talent acquisition or talent management team; selling recruitment process outsourcing (RPO); or selling client-facing talent technology
* A track record in complex, multi-stakeholder engagement cycles
* Experience gaining access to senior leadership and developing ongoing growth opportunities
* Experience engaging CHROs, CPOs, or CFOs
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent demonstrated capability

**Preferred, not required**

* Health system, payer, or healthcare staffing and RPO background
* Working knowledge of clinical labor economics (agency premium, differentials, ratios)
* HR tech or talent acquisition experience
* Prior consulting, banking, or operator background (super helpful)

**How success is measured**

**Primary**

* **Pipeline generated:** qualified enterprise opportunities sourced and advanced.
* **New customers onboarded:** new logos signed and live.

**Leading Indicators**

* **Executive access:** documented CHRO, CPO, or CFO conversations per target account.
* **Diagnostic accuracy:** how often the pre-outreach hypothesis holds up when tested with the client.
* **Business case quality:** engagements carrying a client-validated financial model.
 

 

**Compensation**

* $250,000 - $300,000+ OTE
 

 
 

**Benefits**

We want you to be your best self and to pursue your passions!

* Benefits/programs to support holistic employee health
* Flexible hours and working schedules
* Growing organization with career pathing and development opportunities
* Tons of perks and extras in every location for all Phenoms!
 

 

**Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion**

Our commitment to diversity runs deep! Diversity is essential to building phenomenal teams, products, and customer experiences. Phenom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer taking collective action to build a more inclusive environment where every candidate and employee feels welcomed.

 
 

We recognize there is more to be done. Our teams are committed to continuous improvement until these powerful ideas are ingrained in our culture for Phenom and employers everywhere!

card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
**PLANT OPERATIONS CAREERS**

Plant Manager

Lead a healthcare laundry plant.

**Where** [City, ST]

**Reports to** General Manager / Regional Vice President

As Plant Manager, you'll lead the full plant (production, maintenance, quality, and logistics) with accountability for safety, budget, and the healthcare customers who depend on clean, safe linen every day.

Why you'll like it here

**Own the plant**

Daily operations, people, budget, and results.

**Lean in action**

Drive improvement with Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma.

**Lead leaders**

Develop supervisors, maintenance staff, and production Associates.

**Healthcare standards**

Run an operation held to OSHA and HLAC requirements.

What you'll own

* Lead and manage the Safety & Health Program within the production environment.
* Lead, motivate, and develop a team of supervisors, maintenance staff, and production associates.
* Oversee daily plant operations, including production scheduling, labor forecasting, staffing, and workflow optimization.
* Drive process improvements using Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Manage plant budget, including labor, maintenance, and operational expenses.
* Oversee inventory management to ensure consistent material supply and stock levels.

What you need

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, or Business Administration required.
* 5–7 years of leadership experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Strong end-to-end understanding of plant operations, including safety, quality, maintenance, and compliance.
* Proven experience managing P&L, budgeting, payroll, and cost controls.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and strategic thinking skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and ERP systems.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.

**Physical requirements**

* Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout a manufacturing facility for extended periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift up-to fifty (50) pounds.
* Comfortable working in a plant/production environment.
* Ability to push and pull carts of linen regularly.
* Ability to use required personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, hearing protection, and work boots.

**Bonus points**

* Experience with Lean Manufacturing and/or Six Sigma methodologies preferred.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification.
* Willing to relocate- GOE flexibility.
* Prior military leadership experience (e.g., Sergeant or above) a plus.
* Familiarity with ISO 14001 / ISO 9001 and GMP standards.
* Experience with manufacturing systems and reporting tools

**We'll teach you:** Our plant network, operating standards, and the support of a national organization.

How we work

Every ImageFIRST Associate lives our four Core Values. These are our required competencies.

**Be Respectful**

Value all we come in contact with.

**Be Remarkable**

Create a positive moment with every interaction.

**Be Safe**

Keep ourselves and those around us safe.

**Be Honest**

Be guided by truthfulness in all we do.

Great work gets noticed

**Everyday recognition**

Coworkers nominate each other for going above and beyond, and those nominations go up in the office for everyone to see.

**All Stars & Council of Excellence**

Each year, Associates who live our values are nominated as All-Stars and earn a certificate and a cash award. Top winners join the Council of Excellence with an additional reward.

Benefits

Weekly pay

Medical, Dental, Vision

Pet, Legal, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance

401(k) with company match

Paid Time Off package

Paid Parental Leave

Tuition Reimbursement

Referral Program

Great company culture

Collaborative team environment

 

**MILITARY & VETERANS**

Served? Your skills fit here.

Officers and senior NCOs who led maintenance, logistics, or production operations: command a plant. Whether you're transitioning out, serving in the Guard or Reserve, or a veteran, we want to hear from you.

* Leading a unit leading supervisors, maintenance, and production
* Readiness and inspections safety, quality, and compliance
* Resource stewardship plant budget and cost control

Guard and Reserve members: we support your service commitments. Tell us your branch and specialty when you apply.

 

Who we are

ImageFIRST is the nation's largest medical-focused linen and laundry provider, serving health systems, hospitals, and outpatient facilities since 1967. We run more HLAC-accredited facilities than anyone else, and 97% of our customers stay with us.

Our mission: improving the lives of our associates, our customers, and the patients they serve.

**If you're ready to own a plant's results, apply today.**

 

**Equal Opportunity Employer / Drug-Free Workplace**

We maintain a drug-free workplace in compliance with state and federal law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are fueled by the talent, passion, and diversity of our associates.

card.description:
**Job Description Summary:**

At The Coca-Cola Company, we bring together the power of our people, our brands, technology and innovation to refresh the world and make a difference. Our manufacturing operations are critical to delivering quality products safely, efficiently and reliably, and automation plays an increasingly important role in how we build the manufacturing environment of the future.

 

The **Senior Manager, Automation and Controls** will be based at our Ontario, California facility and will lead automation and controls capabilities that support safe, reliable and efficient manufacturing operations. This role will have primary responsibility for the Ontario facility while providing limited automation and controls support to our Portland facility, requiring approximately 5% travel.

This position will lead a small team of Automation and Controls Technicians and serve as a senior technical resource for automation, controls, instrumentation and manufacturing systems. The role will partner closely with Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, Quality, Safety and Information Technology teams to improve equipment reliability, strengthen controls infrastructure, support capital projects and advance manufacturing technology.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in industrial automation and controls with practical manufacturing experience, strong problem-solving capabilities and effective people leadership. They bring a continuous-improvement mindset and can translate operational challenges into sustainable automation solutions while developing the technical capabilities of their team.

 

**Key Responsibilities and Position-Related Functions**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Lead and develop a small team of Automation and Controls Technicians, establishing clear priorities, technical standards, development plans and expectations for safe and effective execution.
* Provide technical leadership for the Ontario manufacturing facility across industrial automation, programmable logic controllers (Rockwell PLC Platform), human-machine interfaces, supervisory control systems, instrumentation, industrial networks, motion control and related manufacturing technologies.
* Ignition Software Platform and Database Development experience.
* Provide limited automation and controls support for the Portland facility, including technical troubleshooting, project consultation and alignment on controls standards, with approximately 5% travel.
* Partner with Operations, Maintenance and Engineering teams to identify chronic equipment issues, determine root causes and implement controls and automation solutions that improve reliability, throughput and operating performance.
* Lead troubleshooting of complex controls and automation issues, using structured problem-solving, equipment data and technical expertise to reduce downtime and prevent recurrence.
* Establish and maintain controls standards, system documentation, software backups, change-management practices and lifecycle strategies for automation assets.
* Support capital projects from concept through commissioning by developing technical requirements, evaluating automation solutions, reviewing control system designs and ensuring successful installation, testing, start-up and handover.
* Partner with internal teams, original equipment manufacturers, system integrators and other technical suppliers to ensure automation solutions meet operational requirements and established Coca-Cola standards.
* Develop strategies for managing aging or obsolete controls hardware and software, prioritizing replacements based on operational risk, equipment criticality and business needs.
* Strengthen preventive and predictive maintenance practices for automation and controls systems to improve equipment availability and reduce unplanned failures.
* Use manufacturing and controls data to identify performance trends, recurring losses and improvement opportunities, translating data into actionable recommendations.
* Advance digital manufacturing capabilities by evaluating appropriate applications of connected systems, advanced analytics and artificial intelligence-enabled tools to improve troubleshooting, reliability and decision-making.
* Collaborate with Information Technology and appropriate cybersecurity partners to help protect industrial control environments, maintain appropriate system access and support secure industrial network architecture.
* Ensure automation work supports applicable safety, quality, environmental and regulatory requirements, including safe equipment design and control of hazardous energy.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify systems, improve equipment performance, reduce waste and energy consumption, and increase the long-term reliability and maintainability of manufacturing assets.
Build technical capability across the organization through coaching, documentation, standardized troubleshooting practices and knowledge sharing with technicians, maintenance teams and other manufacturing partners. 

**Education and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in industrial automation, controls engineering, electrical systems or manufacturing engineering, preferably within a high-speed manufacturing, food and beverage, consumer packaged goods or similarly complex production environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading, supervising or developing automation, controls or technical professionals in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of programmable logic controller programming, human-machine interfaces, industrial controls, instrumentation, variable-frequency drives, servo or motion systems and industrial communication networks.
* Experience troubleshooting complex automated equipment and applying structured root-cause analysis to recurring equipment and controls failures.
* Experience supporting manufacturing capital projects, including controls specifications, design review, system integration, factory or site acceptance testing, commissioning and start-up.
* Working knowledge of industrial control system cybersecurity principles, network segmentation, access management, backup and recovery practices, and disciplined automation change management.
* Strong data literacy with the ability to use manufacturing information, equipment data and digital tools to identify trends, diagnose performance issues and prioritize improvement opportunities.
* Demonstrated digital fluency and an understanding of how advanced analytics and artificial intelligence tools can responsibly support manufacturing reliability, troubleshooting, predictive maintenance and operational decision-making.
* Knowledge of electrical and machine safety practices and applicable industrial standards, with the ability to integrate safety requirements into automation and controls solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing technical priorities, respond effectively to critical manufacturing issues and balance immediate production needs with sustainable long-term solutions.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to explain complex technical issues to technical and non-technical partners and influence decisions across Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Safety and Information Technology.
* Experience managing vendors, system integrators and original equipment manufacturers, including technical scope, execution expectations and solution quality.
* Proven ability to coach and develop technical team members while building accountability, knowledge sharing and consistent technical practices.
* Continuous-improvement mindset with experience applying structured problem-solving, reliability or Lean manufacturing methods to improve manufacturing performance.
* Understanding of sustainability principles and the role automation can play in reducing energy consumption, material loss, waste and manufacturing inefficiency.
Ability to provide limited support to the Portland facility and travel approximately 5% based on business needs. 

**What We’ll Do for You**

* Provide the opportunity to shape automation and controls capabilities at a critical manufacturing facility while directly influencing safety, reliability, productivity and the evolution of our manufacturing technology.
* Give you the opportunity to lead and develop a specialized technical team while remaining closely connected to hands-on engineering, troubleshooting and manufacturing improvement work.
* Expand your exposure to advanced manufacturing technologies, digital tools, data analytics and emerging artificial intelligence applications as we continue to evolve how our manufacturing operations work.
* Connect you with engineering, operations and technical professionals across the Coca-Cola system, providing opportunities to broaden your manufacturing expertise while solving meaningful operational challenges.

The Coca-Cola Company will not offer sponsorship for employment status (including, but not limited to, H1-B visa status and other employment-based nonimmigrant visas) for this position. Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.

Cross-Functional Teamwork, Efficiency Optimization, Program Management, Quality by Design, Risk Assessments, Technical Innovation

United States: 131,000 - 175,000 USD

United States of America

Ontario

00% - 25%

Yes

December 4, 2026

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola.

card.description:
**Senior Director, Manufacturing Operations**

*Own the supply chain and CMC project engine behind Nurix's clinical programs and commercial readiness. In this multifaceted role, you will select and manage CMOs, keep clinical supply flowing to trial sites around the world, and drive cross-functional CMC plans from early development toward commercialization, in a small, entrepreneurial environment with broad responsibilities.*

 

**Position Description**

The position is a multifaceted role supporting several areas within the Technical Operations group, including supply chain management, CMC project management, and clinical labeling and distribution. The ideal candidate will be highly motivated and self-directed, with experience and interest in working in a small, entrepreneurial environment with broad responsibilities and opportunities.

 

**The Opportunity**

* Lead the effort to identify, select, and manage Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) for the development and cGMP manufacture of raw materials, RSMs, and DS in support of ongoing clinical programs and commercial products (with finance and commercial teams)
* Manage global supply chains and logistics in support of demand for clinical studies and commercial products
* Working in conjunction with technical teams, provide vendor management support in all logistics and operations to ensure on-time delivery of materials
* Coordinate the design and execution of cross-functional CMC project plans and budgeting for early clinical development through commercial readiness
* Maintain frequent communication with cross-functional CMC project team members and key internal stakeholders so that all parties are aware of current project status, issues, contingencies, milestones, and budgets
* Proactively identify the CMC critical path, risks, and impediments to successful development, and drive the identification and development of solutions to mitigate these risks
* Serve as primary clinical supply chain contact, working collaboratively with internal and external partners
* Manage clinical supply planning and forecasting for study protocols and develop packaging/labeling and global distribution strategies
* Monitor IXRS portal processes, including high and low enrolling site settings, drug acknowledgement, depot and site supply levels, and IMP status of released lots or expired drug
* Coordinate the preparation and/or review of CMC sections of INDs, CTAs, NDAs, MAAs, and other regulatory submissions to ensure timely distribution of clinical trial materials
* Coordinate the process validation programs to support commercialization
* Initiate and manage high-value intercontinental, cross-border, and domestic shipments
* Coordinate the preparation, review, editing, and approval of cGMP batch records and CMC regulatory and Quality documents
* Coordinate the preparation of technical reports, publications, and oral presentations

 

**What You'll Bring**

* BS with 15+ years' experience; degree in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Science, or a related scientific discipline
* At least 10 years of relevant experience in a pharmaceutical or biotechnology CMC/cGMP environment
* Excellent project management skills and the ability to work cross-functionally to develop and execute project plans
* Experience managing US and international CRO/CMOs for the manufacture of raw materials, RSMs, and cGMP DS and DP for programs in development
* Experience with clinical supply chain, including forecasting supply needs
* Experience with cGMP manufacturing and IND, CTA, and NDA filings; thorough knowledge of relevant FDA and EMEA regulations
* Experience in supply chain management, and experience establishing pharmaceutical supply chain systems and networks
* Able to identify and resolve critical issues
* Sufficient technical background and experience to work closely with other technical functional areas
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and exceptional interpersonal and management skills to collaborate with others on assigned projects (including both internal teams and external collaborators)
* Bonus: Advanced degree in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Science, or a related scientific discipline
* Bonus: Experience managing US and international CMOs for commercial programs

 

**Salary Range:** $270,300 - $295,700

*The posted range applies to roles based in the San Francisco Bay Area and reflects local market conditions. Where an offer lands within that range depends on the candidate's relevant experience, technical expertise, and how their background aligns with the role's requirements.*

 

**Location:** Onsite – Brisbane, CA

 

**Fit with Nurix Culture and Values**

* Strong team orientation; highly collaborative
* Solutions and results-oriented focus
* Hands-on approach; resourceful and open to diverse points of view

 

**About Nurix Therapeutics**

*Nurix Therapeutics is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of targeted protein degradation medicines, the next frontier in innovative drug design aimed at improving treatment options for patients with cancer and inflammatory diseases. Powered by a fully AI-integrated discovery engine capable of tackling any protein class, and coupled with unparalleled ligase expertise, Nurix's dedicated team has built a formidable advantage in translating the science of targeted protein degradation into clinical advancements. Nurix aims to establish degrader-based treatments at the forefront of patient care, writing medicine's next chapter with a new script to outmatch disease.*

card.description:
**VP of Production**
--------------------

**Location:** Los Angeles, Detroit, or San Francisco 
**Employment:** Full time, in person 
**Base salary:** $200,000–$350,000 annually

American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company supplying raw metal to frontier American manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to factories faster than the industry thought possible.

### **The role**

We’re hiring a VP of Production to lead manufacturing performance across Nox Metals’ facilities. You will own how work moves through our factories: production planning, daily execution, capacity, staffing, quality, productivity, and on-time delivery.

This is a hands-on manufacturing leadership role with real time on the factory floor. You will develop production leaders, resolve constraints, and create repeatable ways of working that help teams deliver as demand grows. Success means safe, reliable production and clear accountability from the daily schedule through completed customer orders.

### **You will**

* Lead production execution across facilities, with clear expectations for safety, quality, output, cost, and delivery.
* Translate demand into practical production, staffing, shift, and capacity plans.
* Develop plant and production leaders who take ownership of results and build strong teams.
* Establish daily operating reviews, shift handoffs, escalation paths, and performance measures that drive action.
* Identify bottlenecks, reduce downtime and rework, and improve material flow and labor productivity.
* Build consistent training, work instructions, and qualification standards while staying close to how work happens.
* Protect material traceability and quality throughout production.
* Partner with maintenance and engineering on equipment reliability, capacity improvements, and automation.
* Work with supply chain and commercial teams to align material availability, production commitments, and customer needs.
* Partner with finance on production economics and equipment investment decisions.
* Help new or expanded facilities establish reliable production and sustain performance as they ramp.

### **You are**

* A manufacturing leader with a record of improving factory performance and developing accountable leaders.
* Experienced managing production teams, schedules, equipment constraints, and competing priorities.
* Uncompromising about safety, quality, and traceability.
* Fluent in capacity, throughput, labor productivity, downtime, and delivery performance.
* Comfortable making decisions on the floor and following through until problems are resolved.
* Practical, direct, and interested in improving manufacturing with software and automation.

### **Nice to have**

Experience leading multiple facilities, scaling production through rapid growth, or working in metals, machining, aerospace, industrial distribution, or related environments.

Expect regular time at our manufacturing facilities and travel between sites as needed.

Nox Metals is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skill, attitude, and fit for the work, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, height, weight, marital status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act.

Compensation Range: $200K - $350K

card.description:
**Company Description**

Sirtex Medical is a global leader in healthcare, with offices in the U.S., Australia, Germany, and Singapore, dedicated to improving patient outcomes.

Our mission is to be at the forefront of minimally invasive cancer and embolization therapies. By partnering with physicians, we aim to provide innovative products that enhance patient outcomes and simplify treatments. Achieving this ambitious goal requires passionate and talented individuals who are committed to making a difference. Our flagship product, SIR-Spheres® Y-90 resin microspheres, is a targeted radiation therapy for liver cancer. To date, we have delivered over >150K doses across 50+ countries, significantly impacting patients' lives worldwide. Our success is fueled by our dedication to serving the medical community, maintaining professionalism, fostering a collaborative work culture, nurturing an entrepreneurial spirit, and continuously pursuing innovation and improvement.

At Sirtex, we are committed to creating a great workplace. We offer a range of benefits, programs, and services to support our employees, ensuring they have opportunities to contribute to our success and advance their careers. Join our inclusive community, where you can collaborate with talented colleagues, bring your ideas to life, and advance your career, all while delivering innovative healthcare solutions to patients.

 **Job Description**

**SCOPE:**

The Wilmington plant is the largest of 3 global Sirtex manufacturing site and serves as the principal production site of both SIR-Spheres microspheres and Lava product lines. The Plant Manager is responsible for leading the sites manufacturing operations, engineering, warehouse and product distribution.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

 

* Develop and lead execution of the site manufacturing strategy for both the SIR-Spheres and Lava value streams. Align site goals with Senior Leadership and Corporate objectives.
* Team Performance Management: lead, develop and mentor manufacturing team members.
* Manage production schedules, ensuring resource availability and capacity to meet demand, working closely with the Supply Chain team, using optimal schedules to minimize overall costs.
* Lead Continuous Improvement efforts, identifying process, equipment, product, and other opportunities, that reduce cost, improve quality and safety at the site.
* Full responsibility for developing and managing to site budget.
* Ensure resource and equipment capacity to ensure efficient and reliable manufacturing.
* Set site target KPI’s managing OEE, Labor Efficiency, Scrap, Equipment Utilization, etc.
* Ensure product is built to specification and in compliance with all Quality System requirements.
* Manage the site engineering team to ensure equipment and processes are robust and meet all manufacturing requirements. Manage PM strategy and ensure that execution is completed on time.
* Support the Quality Department, working with on site Quality team members to ensure that compliance with all areas of the Sirtex QMS are being followed. Identify opportunities for improvement and work to implement them directly in the QMS.
* Work in conjunction with HSE/Facilities Department to ensure a safe working environment for all employees and that the facilities is maintained, and compliant with regulatory requirements for both the handling of radioactive materials and medical device manufacturing.
* Manage all shipping, receiving and warehousing activities. Ensure timely material receipt, inventory accuracy is maintained, and products are shipped on time.

 
**Qualifications**

**EDUCATIONAL PREREQUISITES AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related discipline such as Chemistry or Biomedical field
* 5+ Years experience working in medical device or pharmaceutical industry preferred.
* Prior experience working with radioisotopes preferred.
* 3+ years of site management experience, with 10+ years of leadership experience.
* 6 Sigma Green belt preferred. Experience using 5S and Lean principles is preferred.

The anticipated annual base salary range and target bonus opportunity is $136,000 to $171,000 annually, plus a 15% target annual bonus.

The final position level and compensation will be determined based on non-discriminatory, job-related factors, including geographic location, skills, experience, education, and alignment with the position requirements. In addition to base salary and bonus eligibility, Sirtex offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid sick and vacation time, medical, dental, vision and life insurance, and a generous 401(k) matching program and other benefits, subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

 **Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines

Do you want to be part of something bigger? A team whose impact stretches across the globe making a real difference to the quality of people’s lives. Sirtex recognizes that well-being, financial health, and work-life balance are crucial for our employees to achieve personal success.

Sirtex offers qualified candidates:

* Diverse and flexible work arrangements to achieve the optimum balance between work and personal responsibilities.
* A culture of respect, diversity, collaboration, and innovation fostering inclusiveness and superior performance.
* Attractive compensation and benefit packages which are practical, robust and equitable.
* A commitment to support ongoing professional growth through career development, on the job experiences and training opportunities.
* Challenging work which supports the development of new and better ways to improve clinical outcomes for oncology treatment around the world.
* An unwavering commitment to company values, employee safety and excellence in everything we do.

Diversity drives innovation; inclusion fosters belonging, growth and success. Sirtex believes that it takes multiple perspectives and voices to create a culture and workplace which fosters engagement, teamwork, and employee satisfaction to perform our best and deliver on commitments. We are dedicated to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, included, and can share their ideas so that we can exceed even our own expectations.

Sirtex is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Sirtex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
Description:

The Plant Manager is a senior leader responsible for planning, directing, and controlling activities of a plant to accomplish budgeted operational and financial objectives. Directs all functions at the plant including production, quality control, finance, purchasing, inventory control, manufacturing, engineering, and employee relations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on, data-driven leader capable of scaling production capacity, optimizing labor efficiency, managing complex capital projects, and building a high-performing, engaged workforce.

This role is responsible for the achievement of all operational financial goals. The responsibility also includes establishing and managing operational policies and procedures, creating and maintaining a safe and quality-minded work environment, and fostering the development of a well-trained and motivated work force at all levels.

LALA US Omaha Dairy manufactures yogurt smoothies and pourable sour cream. The facility provides a clean work environment, well-lit, highly automated production facility and career advancement opportunities. LALA US provides a competitive total compensation package including:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401k with company match
* Vacation and Personal time off
* 10 paid holidays
* Company-paid life, AD&D, short-term disability and long-term disability insurance
* Employee Assistance Program

**Core Responsibilities**

**1. People leadership, talent development & labor relations**

* Recruit, mentor, and evaluate department manager, superintendent and shift supervisors, establishing clear accountability and succession plans.
* Foster positive employee relations, high retention, and strong shop-floor morale through transparent communication, town halls, and recognition programs.
* Manage collective bargaining agreement administration, grievance resolution, and constructive relationships with union leadership.

**2. Production & operational execution**

* Direct multi-shift manufacturing operations to consistently achieve daily, weekly, and monthly production schedules and On-Time In-Full delivery targets.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including Overall Equipment Effectiveness, scrap rates, yield, labor variance, and cycle times.
* Optimize production scheduling, capacity planning, and bottleneck management in partnership with Supply Chain and Materials teams.

**3. Financial management & P&L ownership**

* Develop, manage, and justify the annual plant operating budget, focusing on direct/indirect labor costs, raw material utilization, and overhead absorption.
* Track, analyze, and drive corrective actions on manufacturing cost variances, specifically Material Usage Variance, Labor Efficiency Variance, Scrap/Yield losses to protect margins.
* Partner with Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain to investigate unfavorable material usage variances caused by Bill of Materials inaccuracies, machine calibration drift, or substandard raw materials.
* Conduct monthly financial variance reviews with corporate finance to identify cost-saving opportunities and mitigate inflationary pressures.

**4. Continuous improvement & operational excellence**

* Embed Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies (CILA, Centerline, 5S, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, TPM, SMED) into daily floor operations.
* Lead cross-functional continuous improvement events aimed at eliminating waste, reducing changeover times, and improving throughput.
* Leverage Manufacturing Execution Systems and ERP data to drive predictive decision-making and real-time floor visibility.

**5. Environmental, health, and safety leadership**

* Champion a zero-incident safety culture by enforcing strict adherence to OSHA regulations, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures, and company safety policies.
* Lead root-cause investigations for all near-misses, recordable incidents, and environmental excursions, ensuring timely corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Oversee environmental compliance, including EPA permitting, hazardous waste disposal, emissions monitoring, and sustainability targets.

**6. Quality assurance & regulatory compliance**

* Partner with the Quality Manager to reduce Customer Complaints, Cost of Poor Quality, and internal rework.
* Ensure the facility maintains strict compliance with industry quality standards (GMP, & SQF).
* Lead internal, customer, and third-party regulatory audits with zero major non-conformances.

**7. Maintenance, reliability & facilities management**

* Partner with the Engineering manager to achieve the goals on the Preventive and Predictive Maintenance programs to maximize asset reliability and minimize unplanned downtime.
* Ensure spare parts inventory management is optimized to balance carrying costs with equipment uptime requirements.
* Maintain physical plant infrastructure, utilities, security, and building compliance.

**Core Competencies & Attitudes**

* **Unbeatable attitude & resilience**: Maintains an optimistic, "can-do" mindset in the face of complex operational challenges, viewing equipment breakdowns, supply chain disruptions, and cost variances as solvable problems rather than roadblocks.
* **Passion for manufacturing excellence:** Brings genuine energy, pride, and enthusiasm to the shop floor, inspiring teams to take ownership of their craft and strive for world-class production standards.
* **Relentless focus on results:** Operates with a strong bias for execution and goal attainment, consistently driving teams to hit SQCDME targets and protect plant profitability.
* **Hands-on mindset:** Leads from the shop floor rather than behind a desk; actively walks the floor to observe processes, engage with operators, and solve problems at the source.
* **Extreme ownership & accountability:** Takes full responsibility for plant outcomes to engage the team can be focused on results.
* **Data-driven curiosity:** Approaches operational bottlenecks and cost variances (like Material Usage Variance) with analytical rigor, relying on root-cause data rather than guesswork.
* **Action & sense of urgency:** Responds swiftly to equipment downtime, safety hazards, and quality escapes while keeping teams calm and focused under pressure.
* **Servant leadership & empathy:** Listens actively to frontline workers, removes roadblocks for supervisors, and treats every team member with fairness and respect.
* **Continuous growth & adaptability:** Embraces change, challenges "*the way we've always done it"* and encourages calculated experimentation to improve efficiency.

**Core Soft Skills**

* **Multi-level communication:** Ability to translate complex operational metrics into strategic business updates for corporate executives, while communicating daily goals clearly and respectfully to frontline operators.
* **Conflict resolution & de-escalation:** Skilled at mediating disputes between competing departments and resolving shop-floor personnel conflicts calmly and fairly.
* **Emotional Intelligence:** Reads the moral and stress levels of the workforce, maintaining composure during crises like major line breakdowns, customer audits, or supply chain disruptions.
* **Cross-functional Influence:** Builds strong partnerships without direct authority over supporting teams to secure resources and align priorities.
* **Coaching & talent multiplication:** Focuses on developing future leaders by delegating effectively, giving constructive feedback, and empowering supervisors to make independent decisions rather than micromanaging.
* **Active listening:** Creates psychological safety on the plant floor so operators feel comfortable reporting near-misses, quality issues, or process inefficiencies early.
* **Stakeholder & customer relationship:** Represents the facility professionally during high-stakes customer visits, supplier negotiations, and community or regulatory inspections.

Requirements:

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, Chemical), Operations Management, Supply Chain, or Business Administration.

**Build Your Career with Ashley Furniture- Where Innovation Meets Comfort**

**Who We Are:**

At Ashley, inspiring the love of home is at the heart of everything we do. As the world’s largest manufacturer of home furnishings, we’re more than a business — we’re a family driven by innovation, competitiveness, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. We persevere through challenges, push beyond the status quo, and constantly seek better ways to deliver an exceptional customer experience. Our solutions-first mindset and dedication to growth are why Ashley remains #1 in our industry.

If you’re ready to grow, you’ve come to the right place. With a true “Growth Mindset,” Ashley Furniture invests in developing future leaders and helps every team member learn from the best in the business.

 

**If you are a current Ashley employee**: Please login to your UKG account and apply using the internal job board.

 

**Summary:**

The Ashley Home Delivery (AHD) Operational Excellence Director provides centralized leadership for operational planning, routing, process development, project execution, vendor governance, performance management, and organizational coordination across Ashley Home Delivery. This role translates strategy into repeatable operating standards, disciplined execution, measurable performance, and scalable support.

The Director partners with field leadership and cross-functional teams to improve customer experience, delivery performance, carrier accountability, cost effectiveness, and launch readiness, enabling Regional Directors and market leaders to remain focused on field execution.

**Responsibilities:**

**Operational Planning & Routing**

* Lead the centralized routing organization, establishing operating rhythms, service standards, workload allocation, escalation paths, and accountability.
* Own delivery forecasting, capacity planning, route-planning governance, and resource alignment across AHD markets.
* Develop, document, deploy, and audit routing standards that support safe, efficient, reliable, and customer-focused delivery execution.
* Partner with field leaders to identify capacity constraints, route-quality issues, and execution risks, coordinating corrective actions as needed.

**Operational Excellence**

* Lead the development, maintenance, communication, and adoption of standard operating procedures across Ashley Home Delivery.
* Design and continuously improve end-to-end processes for stand-up, load-out, route monitoring, check-in, returns, recovery, beginning-of-day controls, and end-of-day controls.
* Develop validation, compliance, and audit tools to ensure operating standards are understood, adopted, and sustained.
* Drive continuous improvement through data analysis, root-cause analysis, structured problem-solving, and field feedback.
* Establish governance and documentation processes that preserve institutional knowledge and keep operating standards current.

**3PL & Vendor Management**

* Lead carrier sourcing, due diligence, onboarding, implementation, and performance governance in partnership with Procurement, Legal, Finance, Risk, and AHD leadership.
* Establish consistent business reviews, escalation processes, relationship-management routines, and service expectations for delivery partners.
* Provide leadership for the AHD Claims team and governance of claims administration, disputes, documentation, approval controls, and timely resolution.
* Oversee invoice validation and payment-administration processes, including controls that support accuracy, transparency, and accountability.
* Support contract improvements and ensure approved terms, service levels, and operating requirements are effectively implemented.

**Performance Management**

* Develop and maintain national AHD KPI definitions, reporting standards, scorecards, forecasts, and performance dashboards.
* Establish management routines connecting daily operating controls, weekly business reviews, action plans, and executive-level visibility.
* Analyze performance trends and operational gaps, identify root causes, establish accountable owners, and track corrective actions through resolution.
* Provide decision-ready reporting on customer experience, delivery reliability, productivity, capacity, cost, claims, and carrier performance.

**Strategic Projects & Launch Execution**

* Lead program and project management for AHD market launches, conversions, expansions, and national operational initiatives.
* Establish launch-readiness plans covering schedules, staffing, training, travel, uniforms, fleet, equipment, routing, carrier readiness, communications, and operating controls.
* Coordinate cross-functional implementation activities, manage dependencies and risks, and maintain clear milestones, decisions, ownership, and status reporting.
* Drive post-launch adoption and ensure new processes, tools, contracts, and standards become embedded in routine operations.

**People & Organizational Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and deploy assigned AHD support resources against the highest-priority operational and strategic needs.
* Establish clear roles, decision rights, service expectations, workload priorities, and performance standards for centralized support functions.
* Build a high-accountability, service-oriented culture that partners effectively with Regional Directors, site leaders, carriers, and cross-functional teams.
* Coach and develop team members through ongoing feedback, development planning, and recommendations regarding staffing, selection, recognition, and performance actions in accordance with company policy.

**Qualifications:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in operations, transportation, logistics, supply chain, home delivery, final mile, or a related field.
* 5+ years of leadership experience with responsibility for teams, operational programs, or multi-site/multi-market operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading operational excellence, process improvement, performance management, and large-scale implementation initiatives.
* Experience managing third-party carriers, 3PL providers, vendors, or outsourced delivery operations.
* Experience developing and managing KPIs, scorecards, operating reviews, and performance improvement plans.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects from planning through implementation and sustained adoption.

**Additional Qualifications, Preferred**

* Experience in final-mile delivery, retail distribution, home delivery, furniture delivery, or similar customer-facing logistics operations.
* Strong knowledge of routing, capacity planning, delivery forecasting, carrier management, and operational controls.
* Experience developing SOPs, governance frameworks, compliance processes, and audit programs.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate operational data into clear business actions.
* Proven ability to influence field and cross-functional leaders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong project and change-management capabilities with experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to travel as business needs require.

**Benefits We Offer:**

* Health, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program
* Paid Time Off; increases with years of service
* Generous Employee Discount on home furnishings
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Tuition Assistance
* Ashley Wellness Centers (location specific)
* 401(k) and Profit Sharing
* Life Insurance

**Our Core Values:**

* **Honesty & Integrity:** Acts with transparency, discretion, and ethical judgment. Trusted to handle sensitive information and provide accurate, unbiased insights.

* **Dirty Fingernail:** Takes full accountability for outcomes, not just tasks. Inspects details, ensures data accuracy, and follows through to completion.

* **Continuous Improvement:** Actively seeks better ways to improve templates, tools, and processes. Learns from prior initiatives and embeds lessons into standard work.

* **Growth & Results Focus:** Understands how transformation initiatives drive growth, cost reduction, and profitability. Keeps work aligned to enterprise priorities.

* **Culture of Leadership**: Leads through influence, reliability, and example. Builds trust across functions and supports leaders at every level.

* **Customer-Centric & Boundaryless:** Works across silos for the greater good of the organization. Ensures outputs meet the needs of executives, initiative owners, and teams.

* **Operational Excellence:** Demonstrates strong organizational discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to translate ambiguity into clear, executable tools.

**View Our Corporate Brochure** (https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ashleyfurnitureindustriesllc.com%2Fen%2Fcorporate-brochure&data=05%7C02%7CShLee%40Ashleyfurniture.com%7C7380207222ee4e223aea08dd96e531de%7C5a9d9cfdc32e4ac1a9edfe83df4f9e4d%7C0%7C0%7C638832633331666148%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=wNmuyaqBcPo%2FSsLdHmzI%2F3XX3FQf%2Fjy3iHyYUhbP8V8%3D&reserved=0)

**Plant Manager – Manufacturing**

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced Plant Manager to lead an established, mid-size manufacturing operation in Holt, Michigan. This is an opportunity for a well-rounded manufacturing leader to take ownership of the facility's overall business performance, providing strategic direction and leadership while driving operational excellence, profitability, and continued growth.

Reporting to the VP of Operations, the Plant Manager will have full responsibility for the facility's operational and financial performance, including full P&L accountability. This individual will oversee all aspects of the business, lead and develop the management team, and ensure the facility consistently achieves its financial, operational, quality, safety, and customer objectives.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for a seasoned manufacturing leader who understands how to run a plant as a business. The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of operational expertise, financial acumen, and business leadership, with a proven ability to translate company objectives into measurable results.

This person will be comfortable leading through department managers, establishing accountability, making sound business decisions, and developing a culture of continuous improvement. Equally important is the ability to balance the bigger picture with an understanding of what is happening on the plant floor.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assume full ownership and accountability for the facility's overall performance, including P&L, profitability, operating costs, and financial results.
* Develop and execute annual operating plans, budgets, and business strategies aligned with company objectives.
* Monitor financial and operational performance, analyze results, identify areas of opportunity, and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Provide leadership and oversight across all plant functions, including production, quality, maintenance, materials, shipping, and safety.
* Lead, mentor, and develop the management team, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and performance standards.
* Provide direction and oversight to the Production Manager and other functional leaders, ensuring alignment across departments and consistent execution of business objectives.
* Drive improvements in productivity, labor efficiency, throughput, quality, on-time delivery, and overall operating costs.
* Identify and implement cost-reduction initiatives, process improvements, and operational efficiencies that positively impact the bottom line.
* Maintain strong customer relationships, ensuring customer requirements are met and issues are addressed promptly and effectively.
* Oversee workforce planning, staffing, employee development, and organizational effectiveness.
* Ensure a safe working environment and maintain compliance with applicable safety regulations, quality standards, and other requirements.
* Direct capital planning and investment decisions, evaluating equipment, technology, and facility improvements to support business needs and long-term growth.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators, using data and financial reporting to measure results and drive continuous improvement.
* Partner with senior leadership to communicate facility performance, address business challenges, and identify opportunities for growth and improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Progressive leadership experience in a manufacturing environment, with demonstrated success managing an entire plant or manufacturing operation.
* Previous full P&L responsibility, including budgeting, financial reporting, cost management, and profitability.
* Broad understanding of manufacturing operations, including production, quality, maintenance, materials management, and supporting functions.
* Proven ability to improve financial and operational performance through effective planning, execution, and accountability.
* Experience leading and developing department managers and supervisors, with the ability to build a strong, effective leadership team.
* Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to understand financial statements, evaluate operating costs, and make sound business decisions.
* Demonstrated success with continuous improvement, process optimization, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Strong customer-facing skills and the ability to develop and maintain productive business relationships.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
* A hands-on, approachable leadership style combined with the ability to think strategically and lead at the business level.

**The Opportunity**

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced manufacturing leader to take ownership of an established operation and make a meaningful impact on its overall performance and continued success. The right individual will have the opportunity to influence the business, develop a strong team, and drive improvements across all areas of the facility.

The company offers a competitive compensation package, bonus potential, and a comprehensive benefits program including health, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off.

This is an on-site leadership position in Holt, Michigan.

Thank you for considering this opportunity.

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
